title: Operation Moonwatch and its 36 UFO reports
summary: Beatriz Villarroel tells of Operation Moonwatch and its 36 UFO reports, about 1950s at Harvard, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: so Alan Heinek was helping Whipple in this program and they actually had 36 UFO report that I think Jacquali found that we now uh like also look through.

plain: Beatriz Villarroel, an astronomer, describes Operation Moonwatch, a 1950s sky-watching program run from Harvard by the astronomer Fred Whipple with tracking stations around the world. She says the astronomer J. Allen Hynek helped Whipple, and that the program gathered 36 UFO reports, which she thinks were found by the researcher Jacques Vallée and which her team is now going through. If true, it would mean trained observers logged unexplained objects decades ago in records that are only now being studied.
